emphasis: Baseline plan. Tell your coach what you actually completed.

ignition.name: Movement prep

deposits.title: ROTATIONAL POWER

exercises.name: Rotational Medicine-Ball Slam
exercises.cue: Snap from hips; reset completely. Use only a ball rated for slams.
exercises.prescription: 3 crisp rotational slams/side with controlled retrieval. Light enough to stay fast.
exercises.home: 3 crisp rotational slams/side with controlled retrieval. Light enough to stay fast.
exercises.away: Use the listed unloaded regression or comparable available equipment

deposits.effort: Rest 90 sec. End early if speed drops.
deposits.label: A

deposits.title: DB SPLIT SQUAT

exercises.name: Front-Foot-Elevated Dumbbell Split Squat
exercises.cue: Use a stable low step; front knee tracks over toes; control the descent.
exercises.prescription: 6–8/side; use floor-level stance if no stable riser. Leave 2–3 good reps.
exercises.home: 6–8/side; use floor-level stance if no stable riser. Leave 2–3 good reps.
exercises.away: Use the listed unloaded regression or comparable available equipment

deposits.effort: Leave 2–3 good reps in reserve. Rest is included in the timer.
deposits.label: B

deposits.title: DB FLOOR PRESS + CABLE ROW
deposits.effort: Leave 2–3 good reps in reserve. Rest is included in the timer.
deposits.label: C

deposits.title: ROTATION + MOBILITY

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Low-to-High Cable Rotation
exercises.cue: Stay tall over the kneeling hip; turn through upper back; control the return.
exercises.away: Use the listed unloaded regression or comparable available equipment

exercises.name: Ankle rocks + calf mobility
exercises.cue: Move slowly in a comfortable range. No forcing or bouncing.
exercises.prescription: Alternate gentle knee-to-wall ankle rocks and a comfortable standing calf stretch. Split the allotted time equally between movements and sides; heel stays down.
exercises.home: Alternate gentle knee-to-wall ankle rocks and a comfortable standing calf stretch. Split the allotted time equally between movements and sides; heel stays down.
exercises.away: Use the same comfortable unloaded movements, with a wall or chair for support.

deposits.effort: Leave 2–3 good reps in reserve. Rest is included in the timer.
deposits.label: D

martialSupplement.name: DUMMY LAB · BOTTOM-HALF NECK SAFETY
martialSupplement.home: 7 min slow rehearsal of one familiar sequence from this theme. Pause at the difficult position; record one discovery.
martialSupplement.away: Visualize the same familiar positions and write one question.
martialSupplement.cue: Can I keep my neck long and posture protected while maintaining the underhook?
martialSupplement.text: Optional 7 min slow technical study. Record one discovery. Not conditioning.
